subtitle: 택시 타기 · 문장별 음성 재생

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Could you take me to Grand Central Station, please?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.en: Sure. Do you have any bags?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Yes, just this one. Could you open the trunk?
turns.ko: 네, 이거 하나만요. 트량크 열어 주세요?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.en: About twenty minutes, depending on traffic.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Okay. Could you drop me off at the main entrance?

turns.speaker: Driver
turns.en: Here we are. That's eighteen dollars.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Here's twenty. Keep the change. Thank you!

tips.en: Could you take me to ~, please?
Could you drop me off at ~?

desc: 택시 타고 목적지 말하고 요금 낼 때
